proposal.reason: Main change is a full rewrite of open-source test execution orchestration: replacing the old PPU PR test workflow with source-sanity, CSV-driven case selection/execution, artifact-backed build/cache staging, and result reconciliation scripts/tests. Add workflow because the PR also makes independently substantive contribution/review-gate policy changes (PR prechecks, AI+human approval sequencing, and final hosted gate requirements) beyond normal test execution.
